text: Sell RGTI now — down 36.5% with revenue shrinking 34%, the company is burning cash, and 15% of shares are being bet against it, meaning the market expects more pain ahead.
Sell SGLP.L — down nearly 15% with the weakest possible relative strength reading, this commodity holding has no momentum and no reason to keep holding through further decline.
Trim QBTS — the company is losing money, down 21.6% with nearly 47% off its highs and heavy short interest at 15.5%, meaning too much risk to hold a full position.
Trim KTOS — down 24.5% and more than 55% off its high is a severe drawdown, and even a compelling defense drone story doesn't justify this level of loss without reducing exposure.
Trim IONQ — despite a small 6.2% gain, the company loses money, burns cash, and has 10% short interest, so take some off the table before the next downdraft.
Add to MSFT — Microsoft is a premier business down 14.2% and 22.6% off its high, which is a rare pullback worth leaning into given its strong fundamentals and dominant market position.
Add to NOW — ServiceNow is down 16.5% but the fundamentals remain strong, making this a quality name worth building into while it's trading at a discount.
